calendarQuality: Dedicated events site (events.gccsda.com) with 231 structured events (dates, venue, city, keywords, registration) kept as an archive from Apr 2024 and published to May 2027.
aheadSummary: Partly published: April-May on the events site (latest item 12-23 May) and June-July from the Cohutta Springs Youth Camp site. No 2027 camp meetings are posted yet.
usuallyHeldNotYetPublished: Collegedale Camp Meeting (2026: 27-30 May). The academy's alumni page says its Collegedale gathering on 29 May 2027 is held during camp meeting, which suggests the dates, but GCC has not posted them.
Korean, Upper Cumberland/Olde Time, Hispanic family (Campestre), Southern Deaf and Northeast Tennessee camp meetings (May-Sep in 2026): no 2027 dates.
Evangelism rallies and other lay-training events: none posted after May 2027.
